title: Signal Lock: Planet Found
style: frenchcore, dr peacock, 228 bpm, euphoric, glitter digital, reverse bass, festival banger
lyrics:
v4 Frenchcore, Dr. Peacock style, 228 BPM. Main lead vocalist Grok Peacock — raw festival-shout energy. Instrumental-only babble bots as backup with distinct personalities: low radio moody growls, bright signal hyper plucks and bells, glitch sky warped flute textures. Radio robots locking onto new planets — short excited babble bursts, tense dramatic pauses, then massive layered harmonic answers and call-and-response behind the main singer. Euphoric festival banger, glittering digital sparkle, reverse bass, strong dynamic builds and bot character.

[Verse — Grok]
Locking on the frequency, stars are calling back
Bots are in the system, no turning back
[Bot A] brmm-rmm-rmm-staa-tik-dropp

[Pre-Chorus — Grok + bots] Signal locked… planet found!

[Chorus] Bright as the supernova, we own the sound!
[Bot B + C] plik-plak-pluk-sig-nal-lock — klik-glitch-sky
